verses.text: Hihte pen Hachalyah’ tapa Nehemyah’ kammalte ahi hi: Tua pen a kum sawmnihna kum, Chislev kha sung hi a, kumpi khuapi Susa ah ka om laitakin,
ka sanggamte khat ahi Hanani pen Yahdah pana mite tawh hong tung hi. Keimah in salsuahna pana a suakta-in Yerusalem ah a ciahkiksa Yahdah mite’ thu amaute kiang ka dong hi.
Amaute in kei kiangah, “Salsuahna panin a suakta tua gama omte in haksatna lianpi leh maizumna ngah uh hi. Yerusalem kulhpi kisucim a, a kulh kongpite mei tawh kisusia hi,” hong ci uh hi.
Keimah in tua thute ka zak ciangin tusukin ka kap niloh a, vantunga om Pa mai-ah thungenin an ka tan sung tawntung ni tampi sung ka thuum hi.
Keimah in, “Kong thuum hi; Na Thukhamte khempeuh kemin zuihna tawh nang hong it mite tunga na thuciamna, na hehpihna leh na itna a kem, a lian a kihtakhuai vantunga om Pa Yahweh aw—

Na nasem Israyl mite tangin sun leh zanin nangma mai-ah thu hong ngen niloh na nasempa’ thungetna nong zak theih nadingin Na bil hong ngat inla, Na mitte hong hak in. Nangma tungah ko Israyl mite kong khialh uh mawhnate, kei leh ka pa’ innkuan mawhna kong pulaak hi.

Nangma tungah ka gitloh gamtat khin uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote in na Thukhamte, na ngeina kipte ahi a, Na nasempa Mosheh tungtawna na thupiak ahi biakna ngeina kipte ahi zongin ka zui kei uh hi.
Kong thuum hi; Nangmah in na nasempa Mosheh kiangah, “Thu na palsat uh leh, minamte lakah kong thehthang ding hi;

Ahih hangin Keima lamah nong kihei a, Ka Thukhamte zui-in kanin tuate na hih uh leh, note pawlkhat leimong dong nangawn ah na kithehthang uh hangin, Keimah in tua lai panin amaute khawmin, Ka Min omna-in ka teelsa mun ah amaute ka paipih ding hi,” ci-in na thupiakna phawk ta in.
Tu-in hihte pen na nasemte leh na mite ahi uh hi. Nangmah in na vangliatna leh na thahat khut tawh amaute a tankhia khin hi.

Yahweh aw, kong thuum hi; na nasempa thungetna leh Na Min zahtakna ah a kipaak na nasemte thungetna ah na bilte hong ngat in. Tuni-in na nasempa mavangsak inla, hih mipa mai-ah Nangmah in hehpihna ngahsak in,” ka ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh kei pen kumpipa’ haitawipa ka hi hi.

Kumpi Artaxerxes uk zawh a kum sawmnihna kum, Nisan kha; Kha Masa, sungin, kumpipa aa dingin leenggahzu a kipiak ciangin, keimah in leenggahzu la-in kumpipa ka pia hi. Tua ma-in ama mai-ah cik mahin ka dah ngei kei hi;
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in keima kiangah, “A cina lopi-in bang hangin dah mel pua na hi hiam? Na dahna khat om hi!” hong ci hi. Tua ciangin ka lau lua mahmah a,
kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa nungta tawntung tahen! Ka pu ka pate hankhuk omna khuapi siagawp a, a kulhkongpite mei tawh kisusia ahih ciangin bang hangin dah lo ding ka hi hiam?” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in kei kiangah, “Na deih bang ahi hiam?” hong ci hi. Keimah in ka lungsim tawh vantunga om ka Pa Yahweh tungah thu ka ngen sim a,

tua khit ciangin kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa na lungkim a, nangma mai-ah na nasempa in maipha ka ngah ahih leh, ka puahphat theih nadingin Yahdah gam sunga ka pu ka pate han omna khuapi ah kei nong sawl nadingin kong ngen nuam hi,” ka ci hi.

Ama gei-ah kumpinu a tut laitakin, kumpipa in kei kiangah, “Hih khualzinna bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam? Bang hun ciangin hong ciahkik ding na hi hiam?” ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ahih ciangin kei hong paisak ding kumpipa a lungkim a, tua ciangin keimah in hun khat ka seh hi.
Keimah in kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa na lungkim ahih leh, Yahdah gam ka tun dong amaute in hong paisuaksak theih nadingin Euphrates Gun gal gama gam-ukte aa dingin laikhakte nong pia thei ding hiam?

Yahweh’ Inn kiangah kumpi khua kongpite aa ding, khuapi kulh aa ding, ka omna ding inn lam nadingin sing hong sik nadingin kumpipa gammang tulak kempa Asaph tungah thukip khat zong nong pia thei ding hiam?” ka ci hi. Kei hong ompih Yahweh’ lamlahna khut hangin kumpipa in hihte kei tungah hong pia hi.
Tua ciangin Eurphrates Gun gal gama gam-ukte kiangah pai-in kumpipa’ laikhakte amaute tungah ka pia hi. Tu-in kumpipa in kei hong dal dingin a sakol galkapte hong khasak hi.
Horon mi Sanballat leh Ammon mi ulian Tobyah in hih thu a zak ciangin, Israyl mite phattuam nading a sem dingin mi khat a paina thu hangin amaute lungkim het lo uh hi.
Tua ahi a, Yerusalem ah ka tung a, tua lai-ah ni thum sung ka om khit ciangin,

zan hun laitakin ka tho a, mi tawmkhat tawh ka vakkhia hi. Yerusalem ah sep dingin Yahweh in ka lungsima hong guat thu kuamah ka gen kei a, a tunga ka tuanna simloh kote tawh tuan theihna khatpeuh in zong hong zui lo uh hi.
Kuam Kongpi tawnin Theikungte’ Tuikhuk leh Nin Kongpi lamah zan hunin ka pai a, a kisucim Yerusalem kulhte leh mei tawh a kisusia a kulh kongpite ka veel hi.
Tua khit ciangin Tuinak Kongpi leh Kumpipa’ Bual ah ka paisuak hi; ahih hangin ka tuanna ganhing a paisuak theih nading mun om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zanpi mahin kuam lampi ah pai-in kulh ka veel hi; tua khit ciangin kilehkikin, Kuam Kongpi tawnin khuapi ah ka lutkik hi.

Ka paina ahi a, ka sepna ahi zongin uliante theih loh kalin ka ciahkik hi; tua hi a, keimah in Yahdah mite, siampite, mi liante, uliante ahi a, nasepna ah a kihel ding midangte ahi zongin ka gen nai kei hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in amaute kiangah, “I lungkhamna thu ahi a, Yerusalem a siatna ahi a, a kulhkongpite mei tawh a kisuksiatna ahi zongin na thei uh hi. Hong pai un, eite hong kizahpihin hong kinuihsan nawn loh nadingin Yerusalem kulhpi lamkik ni,” ka ci hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in kei hong lamlak den ka Pa’ khut thu leh kei tunga thu hong gen kumpipa’ kammalte zong amaute kiangah ka gen hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, “Lamkik ding kipan ni,” hong ci uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute, hih a thumaan nasepna a kipan uh hi.

Ahih hangin Horon mi Sanballat, Ammon mi ulian Tobyah leh Arab mi Geshem in hih thu a zak ciangin, amaute in kote hong zahpihin hong nuihsan uh a, “Hih na nasep uh bang ahi hiam? Kumpipa lehdo sawm na hi uh hiam?” hong ci uh hi.

Keimah in a nuai-a bangin amaute ka dawngkik hi: “Vantunga om kote Pa Yahweh in kote tungah mavanna hong pia ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin ko Ama nasepte kipanin ka lam ding uh hi; ahih hangin note in tanh ahi a, hamphatna ahi a, Yerusalem ah ciaptehna zong na nei kei ding uh hi,” ka ci hi.

Tua ciangin Siampi Lian Elyashib leh ama sanggam siampite in Tuu Kongpi a lamkik dingin na a sem uh hi. Amaute in tua pen ap-in, a kongkhakte a thuah uh hi. Amaute in a apsa uh Zakhat Tausang leh Hananeel Tausang ciang dong kulhpite a puahpha uh hi.
Yericho mite in ama zom ah puah uh a, Imri’ tapa Zaccur in amaute zom ah puah hi.
Hassenaah’ tapate in Ngasa Kongpi lampha uh hi. Amaute in a zawlte khungin, a kongkhakte, a kalhnate leh a kalhna zawlte a thuah uh hi.
Amaute zom ah Hakkoz’ tapa Unyah’ tapa Meremoth in puah hi. Amaute zom ah Meshezabeel’ tapa Berechyah’ tapa Meshullam in puah hi. Amaute zom ah Baana’ tapa Zadok in puah hi.
Amau zom ah Tekoa mite in puah uh hi; ahih hangin a mi liante in na sep vante ukna nuai-ah sem nuam lo uh hi.
Paseah’ tapa Yahyada, leh Besodeyah’ tapa Meshullam in Yeshanah Kongpi; Kongpi Lui, puahpha uh hi. Amaute in a zawlte khungin, a kongkhakte, a kilhnate leh a kilhna zawlte a thuah uh hi.
Amau zom ah Euphrates Gun gal gama gam-ukpa thuneihna nuai-a om Gibeon mi Melatyah leh Meronoth mi Yadon in puah uh hi.

Amau zom ah kham seekte khat ahi Harhayah’ tapa Uzziel in puah hi. Tua khit ama zom ah paknamtui bawlpa Hananyah in puah hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Kulh Zai ciang dong Yerusalem kulhte a puahphakik uh hi.
Tua khit amaute zom ah Yerusalem gam phelkhat a uk, Hur’ tapa Rephayah in puah hi.
Amau zom ah Harumaph’ tapa Yedayah in ama inn mai a puahpha hi. Ama zom ah Hashabneyah’ tapa Hattush in puah hi.
Harim’ tapa Malchiyah leh Pahath-Moab’ tapa Hashub in Meikhuk Tausang ciang dong kulhpi khawk dang khat a puahpha uh hi.
Amau zom ah Yerusalem gam phellang a uk, Halloshesh’ tapa Shallum in a sem hi. Amah leh a tanute in puahpha uh hi.

Hanun leh Zanoah mite in Kuam Kongpi a puahpha uh hi. Amaute in lamphakik a, a kongkhakte, a kalhnate leh a kalhna zawlte a thuah uh hi. Amaute in Nin Kongpi ciang dong kulh tong 1,000 a puahpha uh hi.
Beth Haccerem gam a uk, Rechab’ tapa Malchiyah in Nin Kongpi a lampha hi. Amah in lampha-in, a kongpite, a kalhnate leh a kalhna zawlte a thuah hi.

Mizpah gam a uk, Col-Hozeh’ tapa Shallun in Tuinak Kongpi a lampha hi. Amah in lampha-in, a tung khuh a, a kongpite, a kalhnate leh a kalhna zawlte thuahin, David Khuapi pana tuahsukna kahlei ciang dong Kumpipa’ Huan gei-a Shelah Bual kulh a puahpha hi.
Ama khit ciangin Beth Zur gam phellang a uk, Azbuk’ tapa Nehemyah in David’ hankhukte tawh a kigalsai san dong, leh bawltawm bual leh Galhang Inn dong a puahpha hi.
Ama zom ah Bani’ tapa ukna nuai-ah Levi mite in puahpha uh hi. Ama zom ah Keilah gam phellang a uk Hashabyah in ama gam tangin a puahpha hi.
Ama zom ah Keilah gam adang phellang a uk, Henadad’ tapa Bavai’ ukna nuai-ah a sanggamte in kulh a puahpha uh hi.
Ama zom ah Mizpah gam a uk, Yahshua’ tapa Ezer in a kiu-a galvan koihna kahtohna mai san khawk dangkhat a puahpha hi.
Ama khit ah Zabbai’ tapa Baruch in a kiu pan panin Siampi Lian Elyashib’ inn kongkhak ciang dong kulh khawk dang khat a puahpha hi.
Ama khit ah Hakkoz’ tapa Unyah’ tapa Meremoth in Elyashib’ inn kongkhak pan panin Elyahshib’ inn mong ciang dong kulh a dang khawk khat a puahpha hi.
Ama khit ah gamkhenneu kiimkota om siampite in a puahpha uh hi.
Amaute khit ah Benyamin leh Hasshub in amaute inn maisan teng a puahpha uh hi. Amaute khit ciangin Ananyah’ tapa Maaseyah’ tapa Azaryah in ama inn gei san teng a puahpha hi.
Ama khit ah Henadad’ tapa Binnui in Azaryah’ inn panin a kiu leh kulh kiu ciang dong khawk dangkhat a puahpha hi.

Uzai’ tapa Palal in a kiu mai panin kumpi-inn tungnung pana a dawkkhia thukhenna mun cingte; thong, omna mun nai-a tausang tung ciang dong a puahpha hi. Ama khit ah Parosh’ tapa Pedayah in a puahpha hi.
Ophel mualtung gama teng Nethin-te in nisuahna lam manawhin Tui Kongpi gal san ciang leh tausang dawng a puah uh hi.
Amaute khit ah Tekoa mite in Ophel kulh ciang dong tausang dawk lianpi zoma kulh khawk dangkhat a puahpha uh hi.
Siampite in Sakol Kongpi tungteng puahin, khat ciat in amau inn mai san ciat a puah uh hi.
Amaute khit ah Immer’ tapa Zadok in ama inn mai san puah a, ama khit ah Nisuahna lam Kongpi-a kong cing, Shecanyah’ tapa Shemayah in a puah hi.
Ama khit ah Shelemyah’ tapa Hananyah leh Zalaph’ tapa gukna Hanun in kulh khawk dang khat a puahpha uh hi. Ama zom ah Berechyah’ tapa Meshullam in ama leitang mai teng a puah hi.
Ama khit ah kham seekpa Malchiyah in Miphkad Kongpi mai-a letsongte leh sumbawlte inn dong, kiu-a inndei tungnung ciang dong a puah pha hi;
Tua ciangin a kiu-a inndei tungnung leh Tuu Kongpi kikalah kham seekte leh sumbawlte in a puahpha uh hi.
Saballat in kote kulh a ciankikna thu a zak ciangin amah nakpi takin heh a, Yahdah mite a zahpih hi.

Amah in a sanggamte leh Samaria galkapte omin thugen a, “Tua migina lote in bang hih uh ahi hiam? Amaute in biakpiakna bia ding uh ahi hiam? Ni khat thu-in zo ding uh ahi hiam? A kihaltumsa nin bulomtang panin suangtum lakhia zo ding uh ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Ama kiangah a om Ammon mi Tobyah in, “Amaute in bangbangin a ciang uh zongin, ngia khat bek nangawn a tungah kah leh, a kulh-a suangte kicim ding hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin keimah Nehemyah in thungenin, “Yahweh aw, kote thu hong za in; bang hang hiam cihleh kote hong kisimmawh hi! Amau zahpihnate amau lutung mah ah hei inla, salsuahna gam aa dingin amaute kibuluhsak in!
Amau khialhna maisak kei inla, Na mai panin amau mawhna zong phiatkhia kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in nasemte mai-ah na heh nadingin Nang hong phin uh hi,” ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin kote in kulh puahphatna ka zom uh a, mipite in nasep nopna lungsim nei uh ahih manin kulh buppih kizomin a sanna alang ciang bang kizoto hi.
Sanballat, Tobyah, Arab-te, Ammon-te leh Ashdod-te in Yerusalem kulhte a ngei bangin a kipuahphatna leh a kikaknate a kihuk laina thu a zak uh ciangin, amaute heh mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yerusalem hong simin buaina a pangsak dingin amaute khempeuh kipawlin sawmsimna khat geel uh hi.
Ahih hangin kote in i Pa tungah thungenin, hih geelna a nang dingin sun leh zanin a cingte ka koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahdah gam sungah hih bangin kigen hi: Nasemte thazaw ta uh hi. Eite in kulh i ciankik zawh loh zah dong dingin nin lah tam lua mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin i langte in, “Amaute theih loh kalin, amaute lakah i om ding a, amaute i that ding hi. Tua ciangin hih nasepna khawl ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amaute nai-a teng Yahdah mite hong pai uh ciangin, amaute in ko kiangah, “Bangbangin na hei uh hangin kong do veve ding uh hi,” ci-in sawm vei val hong ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kulh nunglam a niampenna mun-awng teng ah namsaute, teipite leh thalte tawh a kithawi, amau beh zui-in mi pawlkhat ka koih hi.

Amaute kihtakna ka muh ciangin keimah dingto-in, mi liante, uliante leh mi khempeuh tungah, “Amaute kihta kei un! A lian a kihtak huai Yahweh phawk unla, na sanggamte, na tapate, na tanute, na zite uh leh na innte uh aa dingin do un!” ka ci hi.
Amau hong sawmna thu kote in ka phawkna uh leh Yahweh in amau geelna a mawkna a suahna thu ka galte un a theih uh ciangin, kulh ah kote khempeuh paikikin, ka nasep ciat uh ka sem uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua hun a kipanin ka mite alang in nasem uh a, adang alang in gal puante silhin, lumte, teite leh thalte a tawi uh hi.
Kulh a ciangkik Yahdah mite khempeuh nungah uliante a om uh hi. Van nawn mite in a khut langkhat ah van tawi-in a khut langkhat ah galhiam a tawi kawm uh hi.
Nasemte khempeuh in a nasep kawmun a pang ah namsau kuah kawm uh a, peengkul muutpa ka kiangah a om hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in mi liante, uliante leh mi khempeuh kiangah, “I nasepna zai-in i kithehthang a, kulh dungah gamlapi kihalin i kikhen hi.
Note in peengkul aw na zak peuhpeuh uh ciangin a ginna munmun ah hong kikhawm un. I Pa Yahweh in eite tangin hong dosak ding hi,” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute alang in teipite tawi-in, khuavak huna kipanin zan hun aksi a suah dong kote in ka nasepna uh ka zom uh hi.

Tua hun lai-in keimah in mipite kiangah zong, “Mikim in amah a huhte tawh zanin Yerusalem sunglam ah om un,” ka ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute zanin galvilte leh zanin nasemte bangin sem thei ding uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin keimah a kipan ka sanggamte, ka nasemte ahi a, kei hong cingte ahi zongin ka puante uh ka suah uh hi. Tui ah a pai hun nangawn ciangun zong mikim in a khut sungah a galhiam a tawi den uh hi.
Mite leh a zite in Yahdah mi a sanggamte tungah lumkim lohna lianpi khat a gingkhiasak uh hi.
“Kote in an ne-in ka nuntak nading uh amaute in an hong piak theih nadingun thuumna-in ka tapate uh leh ka tanute uh ka piak kul uh hi,” ci-in a kiko mi pawlkhat a om hi.
“Kialpi hangin an ka lei theih nadingun kote in ka leitangte, ka leenggui huante, leh ka innte uh ka pong mang khin uh hi,” ci-in a kiko mi pawlkhat a om hi.
“Ka leitangte leh ka leenggui huante man ahi kumpipa’ siah ka piak nadingun sum ka leitawikhin uh hi,” ci-in a kiko pawlkhat zong a om hi.

Amaute in, “I sanggamte mah bangin kote zong si leh sa kibang ka hi uh a, ka tate uh zong amau tate bang mah ahi hi. Ahih hangin kote in sila a suahna dingin ka tapate leh ka tanute uh a tawsawn gawp ka hi ta uh hi! A taktakin ka tanute uh pawlkhat sal suak zo a, ahih hangin amaute tatkhiat nading vangliatna ka nei kei uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh ka lote uh leh ka leenggui huante uh amau aa suakkhin hi!” a ci uh hi.
Amau kikona leh hih ngawhnate ka zak ciangin ka heh suak mahmah hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih thu deih takin ka ngaihsun a, tua khit ciangin amaute ka ngawh a, “Note in na sanggamte tung panin a man tam na la lua uh hi!” ka ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute lungsim zawh nadingin mihon khopna lianpi khat ka nei a,

amaute tungah, “Eite i hih theih lai tengin Gentile mite tunga amau mahmah a kizuak i sanggam Yahdah mite i tankhin hi. Ahih zongin eite kiangah hong kizuakkik ding bek lelin na sanggamte uh a zuak na hi uh hi!” ka ci hi. Nial nading thei lo uh ahih manin amaute a dai dide uh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, “Na gamtatna uh pen man lo hi! I galte ahi Gentile mite’ mawhsakna leh zahpihna i thuak nungsang Yahweh zahtakin kalsuan ding hilo ahi hiam?
Kei ka hi a, ka sanggamte leh ka mite in zong mite tungah sum hitaleh an hitaleh leitawi ka pia uh hi; ahih hangin a meet kilak teltalna khawl ni!

A lote, a leenggui huante, a olive lote, a innte leh amaute tunga na nget uh ahi: sum, an, leenggahzu thak leh olive lak pana a seh zakhat khat na nget uh a meet zong tuni-in amaute tungah piakik un!” ka ci hi.

Amaute thukim uh a, “Kote in a vekpi-in ka piakik ding uh a, tua ciangin amaute kiang panin bangmah ka ngen nawn kei ding uh hi. Nangma nong cih bangin ka sem ding uh hi,” hong ci uh hi. Ahi zongin keimah in siampite samin, amaute hong ciamsa bangin a sep nadingun amaute kiciamna ka bawlsak hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in ka puan-ip singkhia-in, “Hih kiciamna bangin a sem lo mi peuhmah Yahweh in ama inn pan leh ama neihsa leitang panin singkhia tahen. Hih bangin amah kisingkhia henla, hawmsuak tahen!” ka ci hi. Tua ciangin mihon khempeuh in, “Tua bangin piang tahen! HalleluYahweh!” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin a ciamsa bangin a gamta uh hi.

Yahdah gam sungah gam-uk ding ka seh hun, Kumpi Artaxerxes uk zawh a kum sawmnihna kum panin a kum sawmthum le nihna kum ciang dong, kei ka hi a, ka sanggamte ahi zongin gam-ukte’ ngah ante ka ne kei uh hi.

Ahih hangin kei ma-a gam-ukte in mite tungah van gikpi suan uh a, amaute tung panin nisimin an leh leenggahzu ngun shekel sawmli man a la uh hi. Hi mah hi, amau a huhte nangawn mite tungah kiliansak lai uh hi; ahih hangin Yahweh ka zahtakna hangin keimah in tua bangin ka hih kei hi.
Tua sangin keimah in hih kulh tunga nasepna ka zom a, kote in leitang khatpeuh zong ka ngen kei uh hi. Ka mite khempeuh nasem dingin tua lai-ah hong kikhawm uh hi.
Kote kiimkot-a minamte kiang panin ko kiangah hong pai mite banah, mi 150 leh Yahdah uliante ka sabuai a um den uh hi.

Nisimin an nek dinga kibawl bawngtal khat, tuu limci guk leh ak ahi hi. Ni sawm simin leenggahzu tampipi hong kipuak hi. Tua zahin a bei hangin gam-ukpa’ ngah ante ka ngen kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mite genthei lua uh hi.
Yahweh aw, mipite tangin ka sep thumaanna hangin kei hong phawk in.

(Tua hun lai-in kulh kongpi kongkhakte a kithuah nai loh hangin) Eite in kulh ciangkikin a vang khat beek a om nawn lohna thu Sanballat, Tobyah, Arab mi Geshem leh i gal dangte khempeuh in a zak ciangin,

Sanballat leh Geshem in kei kiangah thu hong puakin, “Hong pai in; Ono zanglei-a Kepherim; khuaneute khat, ah kimu khawm ni,” hong ci uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in kei hong suksiat theih nading a ngim uh ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin keimah in amaute kiangah kamtai khat sawlin, “Keimah in nasep lianpi khat ka sem a, kong paisuk thei kei ding hi. Note kiangah hong paisuk dingin nasep ka nusiat sungin nasepna kikhawl ding hilo ahi hiam?” ka cisak hi.
Amaute in a thu kibang mah li vei hong khak uh a; ahih hangin ke’n zong a kibang mahin ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin nidanga a hihsa mah bangin a nga veina Sanballat in kei kiangah ama kamtaipa, laikhak kihongsa khat tawi-in hong paisak hi.
